verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of an overage fee schedule for bandwidth, invocations, or build minutes. The only pricing-related items are community comments that Render's pricing page is easy to understand or needs clicking into each component. Those are general impressions and do not show a published overage rate schedule.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the exact overage fee schedule for exceeding plan usage limits (bandwidth, invocations, build minutes) before I get billed
